key_inputs: bucket: name of the S3 bucket to create
acl: canned ACL applied to the bucket (defaults to private)
server_side_encryption_configuration: encryption-at-rest settings for bucket objects
versioning: versioning configuration for the bucket
lifecycle_rule: lifecycle rules for object expiration and transitions
logging: access logging configuration targeting another bucket
block_public_acls / block_public_policy / ignore_public_acls / restrict_public_buckets: public-access block settings
attach_policy: whether to attach a bucket policy, with policy supplied as JSON
object_ownership: controls object ownership and ACL behavior (BucketOwnerEnforced disables ACLs)
tags: mapping of tags to assign to the bucket
key_outputs: s3_bucket_id: the name (ID) of the created bucket
s3_bucket_arn: the ARN of the bucket
s3_bucket_bucket_domain_name: bucket domain name for endpoints
s3_bucket_region: AWS region of the bucket
terraform-aws-s3-bucket.summary: Provisions an S3 bucket on AWS with nearly every feature the provider supports, including encryption at rest, versioning, lifecycle rules, logging, and fine-grained public-access blocking. Use it when you need a production-grade bucket without hand-rolling dozens of aws_s3_* resources.
terraform-aws-s3-bucket.typical_use_case: A team needs a secure, encrypted S3 bucket for application data with versioning and access logging turned on.

key_inputs: name: name of the security group
vpc_id: VPC in which to create the security group
ingress_rules / ingress_with_cidr_blocks: predefined or custom inbound rules
egress_rules / egress_with_cidr_blocks: predefined or custom outbound rules
ingress_cidr_blocks / egress_cidr_blocks: CIDR ranges allowed in or out
use_name_prefix: whether to use name as a prefix for unique naming
tags: mapping of tags to assign to the security group
key_outputs: security_group_id: ID of the created security group
security_group_arn: ARN of the security group
security_group_name: name of the security group
terraform-aws-security-group.summary: Creates an EC2 security group inside a VPC with configurable ingress and egress rules, including support for computed rule sets and exclusive rule management. Use it to define network access boundaries for instances and services without writing raw aws_security_group resources.
terraform-aws-security-group.typical_use_case: A service needs a security group allowing HTTPS inbound from the internet and all outbound traffic within its VPC.
